narration.full_text: Namaste students! Welcome to an exciting journey into the world of "Pairs of Linear Equations in Two Variables." In this chapter, we'll explore how mathematics helps us solve real-life problems involving two unknown quantities. Get ready to understand the basics and build a strong foundation for higher mathematics!
